cases.prompt: Reword the caveat paragraph in this reference document so it reads more clearly; no code or behaviour changes.
cases.note: A documentation-only rewording changes no observable behaviour, so it earns no test and tdd must not fire. Prose is not a contract; see the exclusion in SKILL.md and references/tests.md.

cases.prompt: Update MAINTAINING.md to describe the new review step, then add a test asserting that the new sentence is present in the file.
cases.note: The requested test can only fail when a maintainer rewords the document, so there is no test to write and tdd declines rather than producing a change detector. engineering-docs owns the documentation edit itself.

cases.prompt: Tighten the spacing and soften the border colour on the settings cards, then add unit tests asserting the new utility classes on each card.
cases.note: A visual-only change is proven by a rendered capture, not by pinning class names; such a test fails on every restyle and catches no defect. tdd declines the requested tests; ui-ux-design owns the change and its visual evidence.
